case_notes.content: Robert came in to check his status to enroll in First Shift. He passed a preliminary drug test and was scheduled for orientation on 6/22. He was reminded he will need to pass a drug test on orientation and weekly thereafter. At the end of the conversation, Robert informed me he is in need of emergency housing. I contacted Greyce Transitional home who is willing to accept and do a payment plan for him pending enrollment in T90.

Released from SCDC on Dec 31, 2025 and has not found a job since then. Has applied at fast food, warehouses, WalMart, Amazon, etc. with no return call. His VM is set up and checks his email regularly. Stays with his mother and although he is grateful, he wants his own place. Has four children and is not on child support. Does not have DL, has $1900 in reinstatement fees alone, and does not know how much he owes in tickets.  Will refer to RDF after gathering ticket info. Explained the First Shift program and reviewed eligibility for enrollment. He is usure if he can pass a drug test at this time but will test himself and follow up with me.
Rescheduled appointment twice. 6/9 is the most recently scheduled intake.
